description: Land Acquisition - Padeniya, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice primarily deals with land acquisition and redemption matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically involves the divestment of a particular allotment of land (Lot No. 3 in Ward 2-Padeniya), including detailed land description, boundaries, and extent. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) despite the mention of a minister's name, as the core subject is land administration rather than government personnel or portfolio responsibilities.
